German Labor Minister Resigns Amid Coalition Friction

Germany's Labor Minister, Bärbel Bas, who is also co-leader of the junior SPD party, has resigned, citing personal reasons and 'attacks' from her coalition partners. Her resignation has caused instability within the governing coalition.
